name: Marine La Valleroy
original_name: マリーヌ・ラ・ヴァルロワ
source:
Princess of Valleroy. She studies swordsmanship and knighthood at the Valleroy Royal Academy. She is a top student with excellent grades. Has a domineering personality and talks in a very high-handed manner but has a very high sense of duty as someone who carries the burdens and responsibilities of royalty.

She is not yet wise to the ways of the world and has a very pure and sincere personality.

Having snuck out of the castle for a certain reason, she meets Aruji when she uses the abandoned inn as a place to stay and ends up becoming the inn's first patron. In order to hide her identity, she introduces herself as "Mylene", a daughter of nobility.

Due to her position as a princess, she's used to changing clothes in front of servants, so she has a somewhat diminished sense of vulnerability about being seen naked. This does not mean that she is completely without shame though.

Also to prepare her for succession to the throne, she has received proper sex education, so she is very knowledgeable about sexual matters. But as she has no actual practical experience (she's a virgin), she's just an armchair expert who lets her imagination and expectations run wild in her head. She's surprisingly proactive and devoted, even willing to perform fellatio and engage in outdoor play.

[Translated from the [url=https://kelpy.net/index02/character01.php]official website[/url]]
